entities.name: Artūras Milaknis

entities.summary: Artūras Milaknis is a Lithuanian professional basketball coach and former player. He is currently an assistant coach for Jonava Hipocredit of the Lithuanian Basketball League (LKL). Standing at 1.95 m, he primarily played at the shooting guard position.
